questions.solution: Huckel's Rule states that an aromatic compound must have an odd number of pairs of electrons expressed as 4n+2. questions.questionHtml: A boat moves 25 km upstream and 39 km downstream in 8 hours. It travels 35 km upstream and 52 km downstream in 11 hours. What is the speed of the stream if it travels at a uniform speed?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of the boat be x km/h, and the speed of the stream be y km/h, According to the question,

\(\frac{25}{x - y} + \frac{39}{x+y}=8\)      ----(i)

\(\frac{35}{x - y} + \frac{52}{x+y}=11\)      ----(ii)

Multiplying equation (i) by 4 and equation (ii) by 3 and then subtracting equation (ii) from (i) we get,

\(\frac{105}{x-y}-\frac{100}{x-y}=33-32\)  ⇒ \(\frac{5}{x-y}=1\) So, x - y = 5

Now, Putting the value of x - y in eq (i) we get, 5 + \(\frac{39}{x+y}=8\) ⇒ x + y = 13

Now, x + y - x + y = 13 - 5 ⇒ 2y = 8 ⇒ y = 4 km/hr

Now, cosec θ + cot θ + cosec θ - cot θ = p + 1/p⇒ 2cosec θ = \({{p^2 \ +\ 1} \over p}\) ⇒ cosec θ = \({{p^2 \ +\ 1} \over 2p}\) ⇒ \({{H} \over P}\) = \({{p^2 \ +\ 1} \over 2p}\) 

So, H2 = P2 + B2 ⇒ (p2 + 1)2 = (2p)2 + B2 ⇒ p4 + 1 + 2p2 = 4p2 + B2 ⇒ p4 + 1 - 2p2 = B2 ⇒ (p2 - 1)2 = B2 ⇒ (p2 - 1) = B

Now, \({{p^2 \ - \ 1} \over p^2 \ + \ 1}\) = \({{B} \over H}\) = cosθ
